Container.Name: ScreamingFrog-SEO-Spider
Container.Overview:
Screaming Frog SEO Spider (UNOFFICIAL) running in your browser via KasmVNC, with the native MCP server (v24+) exposed for Claude Code / Cursor / any MCP client, and optional Tailscale userspace egress so crawls exit through a fixed-IP exit node.
A PAID SCREAMING FROG LICENCE IS REQUIRED for crawls over 500 URLs and for MCP/headless features. This image does NOT bundle Screaming Frog: the official installer is downloaded from screamingfrog.co.uk on first start, pinned by the SF_VERSION variable. Enter your licence once in the GUI — it persists in appdata.
To update Screaming Frog: change SF_VERSION and restart the container. Licence, configs and crawls are preserved.
MCP: enable it inside the app (Settings > MCP Server, base directory /config/mcp-workdir), then on your client: claude mcp add --transport http screaming-frog http://SERVER_IP:11435/mcp
Tailscale (optional, installed at runtime only if enabled): set TS_ENABLED=true. In the SEO Spider set Config > System > Proxy to localhost:1056 so crawl traffic exits via your exit node.
Security: the GUI and MCP ports have no built-in authentication — keep them on your LAN/tailnet only, never expose them to the internet.

Config.Name: WebUI (KasmVNC)
Config.Description: Screaming Frog GUI in the browser (HTTP)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Licence, configs (.seospiderconfig), crawls, exports and MCP working directory

Config.Name: SF_VERSION
Config.Description: Screaming Frog version to install. Change it and restart the container to update.

Config.Name: SF_MAX_MEMORY
Config.Description: Java heap allocation, e.g. 12g. Empty = controlled via the app GUI (File > Settings > Memory Allocation).

Config.Name: TS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Installs and enables Tailscale at runtime (userspace outbound proxy for exit-node egress)

Config.Name: TS_AUTHKEY
Config.Description: Tailscale auth key (optional; without it, authenticate once with: docker exec -it ScreamingFrog-SEO-Spider tailscale up)

Config.Name: TS_EXIT_NODE
Config.Description: Tailscale hostname/IP of the exit node used for crawl egress
